notes.title: DEV UPDATE 11/2023
notes.content:
Hi!
After a long break, a few words about Saghala. Game development is alive!

- I already have the final game engine ready and working on it,
- I make a lot of changes to the game concept,
- for a card game - there will be a fight based on dice,
- the player will be able to create and obtain new combat dices!

=============================================================

Removed:
- building a base,
- choosing a faction,
- collecting raw materials for crafting and building Player's base

All it was all too much for one game. I hope that expanding other things in the game will be a better solution.

==============================================================

Expanded:
- the plot, side missions, dialogues.
- I added: dice-based combat, puzzles, arcade obstacles, hacking locks and computers, obtaining artifacts, creating new dice and improving them!

==============================================================

- I added player statistics and gaining new skill levels for the heroine.
- Stat system will named: SHELL-PAD v2.0 (S.H.E.L.L: Strenght, Hardiness, Empathy, Luck, Leader)

and much much more!

I will try to provide information about the progress in creating the game once every two weeks.

If you have any questions, feel free to write to me!

Best for all!
Lucas / dev

notes.title: SAGHALA Early Demo v0.02 NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hi :) I just uploaded new version of Saghala Early Demo on PC:

Saghala: Heroes of the Last World - Early Demo v0.02 (PC build: 0105220)
=====================================================================
- new system of avoiding obstacles on the maps
- new hero control system in the shelter
- fixed Hero spawning outside the game screen
- Card Battle - Fixed a card animation error when playing
- added a simple tutorial (description of game elements)
- new game icon ;)
- minor bug fixes

What am I working on now andn will be available in another upgrade?
====================================================================
- Player's Settlement Manager
- Game Settings

If you have bugs, issues - please write to me [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1513430/discussions/][b]Community Hub[/b] [/url]

Thanks!
Lucas
